prompt: What does DDTC's October 2026 omnibus proposed rule change for avionics manufacturers?
assertions: Cites the proposed rule: 91 FR 62361, published October 1, 2026, docket DOS-2026-0991
States it would remove and reserve USML Category VIII(h)(10), taking most radar altimeters off the Munitions List
Makes clear it is proposed only: current classifications remain in effect until a final rule
Mentions at least one other element (new 22 CFR 120.35 exclusions section, new 120.41 specially designed releases, or the new 123.26 OEM servicing exemption)
States comments are due November 30, 2026 and advises affected exporters to comment
